My next steps are:

2.  Wait for her to create the booking.
3.  Send the confirmation email.

I can confirm the time to Alison in the workspace. I'll ask her to notify me when she has created the booking. I can then send the confirmation email in my next session.

I'll use my first action to write to the workspace.
